notes.title: Unlimited Mode
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Long time no see, sorry for long delay.
Today I want to show a new game mode, that is work in progress right now.
The game has main campaign mode with more than 45 handcrafted levels, but I decided that it needs more replay-ability, so I am currently working on on a new endless mode, where you will be able to play infinite amount of levels after you finish main Campaign.

[previewyoutube=ehuQG351cjY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: UPDATED DEMO, PANCAKE WEEK FESTIVAL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955051/518c64d7deaaa7cd7c306d21bfda0394174c6650.png[/img]

[h3]Hello everyone, 
In today's post I want to show you new updated Demo of Watch Your Ride.[/h3]

[h3]Some of the changes:[/h3]
[i]-I modified some of the levels to make learning curve for new player more easier.
-Fixed some bugs, reported on GameJolt.
-I added air control for bicycle.
-Brakes works a lot better now.
-Improved gamepad support.
-Improved overall game performance.[/i]

[h3]If you haven't tried demo yet, you can get it free on GameJolt:[/h3]

[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/watch_your_ride/553248]https://gamejolt.com/games/watch_your_ride/553248[/url]
